notes: During 1995, only 6 States reported providing training to their Staff. Of the 6 States,
Maharashtra ranked high by reporting various training (9) imparted to their staff (441) during the year
1995. Uttar Pradesh and Kerala could train their jail staff 615 and 435 respectively. During this time,
Himachal Pradesh (170), Orissa (132) and Rajasthan (142) availed such facilities and trained their
prison staff in Correctional Administration, Drill and Academic and Jail staff training.
Inspection of jail by various authorities, their findings and recommendations in improving the
conditions and the follow up action taken in this regard are some of the regular features in the prison
system to tone up the efficiency and better management in jails.
